keyEvents.text: Delay in match because of an injury Taha Habroune (Columbus Crew).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Inter Miami CF 0, Columbus Crew 1. Gonzalo Tapia (Columbus Crew) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the centre of the goal.
Gonzalo Luján (Inter Miami CF) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Second yellow card to Gonzalo Luján (Inter Miami CF) for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Steven Moreira (Columbus Crew).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Dylan Chambost (Columbus Crew) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Lionel Messi (Inter Miami CF) is shown the yellow card.
Gonzalo Tapia (Columbus Crew) is shown the yellow card.
Yannick Bright (Inter Miami CF) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Inter Miami CF. Matías Galarza replaces Luis Suárez.
Second Half begins Inter Miami CF 0, Columbus Crew 1.
Germán Berterame (Inter Miami CF) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Inter Miami CF 0, Columbus Crew 2. Taha Habroune (Columbus Crew) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Brais Méndez.
Goal! Inter Miami CF 0, Columbus Crew 3. Gonzalo Tapia (Columbus Crew) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Steven Moreira.
Substitution, Columbus Crew. Josef Martínez replaces Gonzalo Tapia.
Substitution, Columbus Crew. André Gomes replaces Dylan Chambost.
Substitution, Inter Miami CF. Alexander Shaw replaces Yannick Bright.
Ian Fray (Inter Miami CF) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Inter Miami CF. Fricio Caicedo replaces Telasco Segovia.
Substitution, Columbus Crew. Eric Bailly replaces Steven Moreira.
Substitution, Columbus Crew. Sékou Bangoura replaces Santiago Rodríguez.
Substitution, Inter Miami CF. Facundo Mura replaces Ian Fray.
Josef Martínez (Columbus Crew) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Columbus Crew. Brooks Lennon replaces Taha Habroune.
Second Half ends, Inter Miami CF 0, Columbus Crew 3.
